name: freeze
description: Freeze a Claude Code session at the next safe boundary and resume it later as if nothing happened (ctrl+x f, /freeze)

shortcut.title: ctrl+x f shortcut
shortcut.description: Show a one-line band above the prompt whose button toggles freeze, pressed by ctrl+x f once bound in ~/.claude/keybindings.json (see README). Off: use /freeze; the state shows in the status line.

pauseBackground.title: Pause background tasks
pauseBackground.description: Once a freeze has settled, pause (SIGSTOP) this session's background tasks (run_in_background commands, monitors, dev servers) and resume them on unfreeze. Off: they keep running while frozen.
